newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to invest $9 bln in power to 2005 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to invest $9 bln in power to 2005 - paper.

text.p: Mexico's Federal Electricity Commission, the national power utility, plans to invest $9 million to the year 2005, the daily El Economista said Thursday.

Citing a report from the commission, El Economista said the investments will be channeled into transmission and distribution projects, promoting the private sector participation under turnkey contracts.
Plan are to boost the national grid by an additional 12,350 megawatts because of an estimated increase in consumption over the next years of 5.1 percent per annum, the daily said.
